points.quote: Declare an interface and a matching identifier with `createDecorator<IFoo>('fooService')`. By convention both are named `IFoo`, with the identifier as a `const` of the same name.
Services are injected as trailing constructor parameters, each annotated with its identifier: ... `@IFooService private readonly fooService: IFooService,`
`instantiationService.createInstance(MyClass, 'static-arg')` supplies the static arguments and resolves the rest from the container.
Singletons registered in `*.contribution.ts` files or in `workbench.common.main.ts`, `workbench.desktop.main.ts` and similar entry points.
